C9000062.statement: Audit the unrestricted contact-Fano and quaternionic-Kahler classification; a verified local mission does not certify the remaining manuscript.

C_DETERMINANT.statement: red:determinant: det(F)=L^n and -K_X=L^(n+1), hence the contact line of a contact Fano manifold is ample.

C_SIMPLE_PIC.statement: red:simply-connected: a smooth complex Fano manifold is simply connected and has free Picard group identified with H^2(X,Z).

C_PICARD.statement: red:alternatives: the given contact structure is either primitive Picard rank one or one of the standard incidence and projective-space structures.

C_LINES_COVER.statement: lines:free-cover: the primitive case has a smooth irreducible family of parametrized free contact lines with smooth dominant evaluation.

C_FREE_EVALUATION.statement: A covering family of free L-degree-one maps supplies a smooth irreducible open Hom family whose evaluation is smooth and dominant.

C_POSITIVE.statement: lines:positive: the intrinsic positive part P_f of a free contact line has trivial tangent quotient and theta(P_f)=0.

C_LINE_DIRECTIONS.statement: At a general point the contact-line tangent directions span P(F_x) and form a smooth possibly disconnected Legendrian variety; the dimension-three endpoint is treated separately.

C_CONE_ADDITION.statement: lines:cone-addition: two components of a smooth projective Legendrian variety with a nonorthogonal pair have dominant affine-cone addition.

C_SUITABLE_PAIR.statement: lines:suitable-pair: there are two free contact lines with nonzero Levi pairing and positive tangent subspaces summing to F_x.

C_FIXED_ENDS.statement: sm:vertical-cokernel and sm:fixed-ends: the nodal two-line evaluation cokernel is L_x and there is no first-order smoothing fixing both outer values.

C_VERY_FREE.statement: sm:very-free: a degree-two immersion g has tangent splitting O(2)+O(1)^(2n), smooth full Hom space, and submersive two-point evaluation.

C_FULL_GERM.statement: sm:full-germ: normalization of the unmarked stable-map component retains the entire nearby parametrized degree-two Hom family.

C_EXT_NORMAL.statement: ext:normal-products: products of flat nodal-curve families over a normal integral base with smooth geometrically integral entire generic fibers are integral and normal, with the stated divisorial points.

C_EXT_TREES.statement: ext:trees: an unmarked stable genus-zero degree-two source is smooth or two degree-one components with one node and no contracted component.

C_EXT_CONTACT_ORDER.statement: ext:contact-order: at a boundary trait uv=tau^r the relative contact differential has order at least r on each component.

C_EXT_POLES.statement: ext:differential-order and ext:pole-table: the contraction differential has order r on the contracted component, and the invariant bivector has mixed-component pole order at most r.

C_MOVING_PAIR.statement: ext:moving-pair: the normalized unmarked universal square and coarse descent yield a proper integral algebraic space dominating X times X, both regular vector lifts, symmetry, and the full Hom-family identity.

C_DES_FINITE.statement: The reduced contact-value image S0 in Tot(L boxtimes L) is finite over Z; its finite normalization S agrees with S0 and is etale over one dense base open.

C_DES_SHEETS.statement: For every test line of either factor type meeting that base open, every dominating component of the normalized finite image pullback has degree one.

C_DES_DETECTION.statement: Every prime divisor on Z is met transversely in its prescribed dense smooth open by a general test line of at least one of the two factor types, avoiding any prescribed codimension-two exceptional set.

C_DES_UNRAMIFIED.statement: A divisorial ramification index e>1 gives a smooth transverse pullback curve germ of index e, contradicting all-sheet degree-one splitting; therefore q is unramified at every height-one source point.

C_DES_INTEGER_ORDER.statement: For every natural e>=2 and integer m, e*m is not 1; therefore a power-compatible integer order with order(t)=1 cannot have z^e=t. This certifies only the local arithmetic obstruction, not the geometric descent theorem.

C_DES_PURITY.statement: Equal local dimensions and purity make q etale everywhere; simple connectedness forces degree one, so S0 is Z and its tautological value is a unique descended section.

C_DES_DESCENT.statement: des:descent with exactly the original hypotheses and arbitrary proper integral algebraic space Y: two regular vector lifts with the same contact value force unique descent to L boxtimes L.

C_DES_FAMILY.statement: des:family: applying descent to the moving-pair construction gives a symmetric tensor B with the displayed identity on the full nearby parametrized family, including the diagonal.

C_JET_SYMBOL.statement: jet:value-velocity and jet:diagonal: very freeness gives an open set of values and velocities, and the full family identity forces B in I_Delta^2 with second symbol theta^2 everywhere.

C_JET_CRITERION.statement: jet:criterion: on a connected compact complex contact manifold a symmetric B with second diagonal symbol theta^2 generates all ordinary first jets of L and gives contact transitivity.

C_CONTACT_TRANSITIVE.statement: jet:transitive: the effective identity component of algebraic contact automorphisms acts transitively on every contact Fano manifold in thm:main.

C_ADJOINT.statement: hom:adjoint: effective connected algebraic contact transitivity and an ample contact line identify the manifold and its given contact structure with the adjoint variety of a simple Lie algebra.

C_MAIN.statement: thm:main: every smooth connected projective contact Fano manifold of dimension at least three, with its given contact structure and polarization, is a simple adjoint contact variety.

C_TWISTOR.statement: tw:section: a closed positive quaternionic-Kahler manifold has a projective contact Fano twistor space, and its sphere bundle and Fano simple connectedness give simple connectedness of the base.

C_METRIC_RECOVERY.statement: tw:section: the complex twistor isomorphism to a Wolf model and LeBrun's normalized metric uniqueness recover a base isometry without presupposing preservation of a chosen real structure.

C_QK.statement: thm:quaternionic: every closed connected positive quaternionic-Kahler manifold of real dimension at least eight is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space and has parallel curvature.
